description: tangent-cylinders-fuse's tool turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a tolerance and a half (1.5e-7) into the target and away from it: the walls cross in a skew section round a sliver at one end. Arris fails: the result's shells do not nest, two of them meet (Fault::Lumps). The desired result is the tangent contact's refusal by name, as at the contact: Open CASCADE reads the pair as touching too and returns the two operands as two shells (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
